BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.implementation() external ifAdmin returns current implementation.

AdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() override; calls super chain.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address,bytes) public payable; unguarded initializer setting implementation and delegatecalling data.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize(address,address,bytes) public payable; sets implementation and admin.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback() override; calls super chain.

ProductProxy._factory() internal view; sload of FACTORY_SLOT.
ProductProxy._implementation() override; resolves implementation through the factory external call.
InitializableProductProxy.initialize(address,bytes) public payable; unguarded initializer storing factory and delegatecalling data.
OpenZeppelinUpgradesAddress.isContract(address) internal view; extcodesize check used to gate the fallback and setters.
Caller-controlled address used for admin authorization, fallback guard and fallback extcodesize check.

edges.reason: fallback() external forwards all calls to _fallback().
receive() external forwards plain ETH transfers to _fallback().
_fallback() invokes the _willFallback() hook before delegating.
_fallback() delegates execution through _delegate(_implementation()).
_fallback() calls isContract(msg.sender) to skip delegation for cheap contract ETH sends.
_fallback() checks msg.sender code size, making the guard depend on caller identity.
_delegate executes the assembly delegatecall, handing control and storage context to untrusted implementation code.
_upgradeTo calls _setImplementation before emitting the Upgraded event.
_setImplementation requires isContract(newImplementation).
_setImplementation performs the sstore of the implementation slot via assembly.
ifAdmin sends non-admin callers to _fallback(), so failed authorization silently reaches the delegatecall path.
ifAdmin compares msg.sender against the stored admin to grant privileged execution.
ifAdmin reads the admin address from _admin() for the authorization comparison.
admin() is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
admin() returns _admin().
implementation() is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
implementation() returns _implementation().
changeAdmin() is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
changeAdmin() writes the new admin through _setAdmin.
upgradeTo() is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
upgradeTo() replaces the implementation via _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall() is gated by the ifAdmin modifier.
upgradeToAndCall() upgrades the implementation before the low level call.
upgradeToAndCall() delegatecalls attacker/admin supplied data after mutating state, an external call into arbitrary code.
_willFallback() requires msg.sender != _admin(), a caller dependent authorization check.
_willFallback() compares the caller with the value read from _admin().
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor initializes the implementation through _setImplementation.
UpgradeabilityProxy constructor delegatecalls the supplied init data, executing arbitrary code during deployment.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor chains to the UpgradeabilityProxy constructor with _logic and _data.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor stores the initial admin via _setAdmin with no validation.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback override calls the BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy implementation.
InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize requires _implementation() == address(0) (only-once guard).
public initialize() sets the implementation slot; protection is only the empty-slot require, front-runnable.
public initialize() delegatecalls caller supplied data, executing arbitrary code on an uninitialized proxy.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize calls InitializableUpgradeabilityProxy.initialize (_logic/_data).
public initialize() sets the admin through _setAdmin, granting permanent proxy privileges to the first caller.
InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy._willFallback override calls the super implementation.
_setFactory requires isContract(newFactory) before writing the factory slot.
_setFactory performs the assembly sstore of the factory slot that later determines the delegatecall target.
ProductProxy._implementation reads the factory address through _factory().
ProductProxy._implementation uses productName() as the implementation lookup key.
ProductProxy._implementation makes an external call to a factory whose returned address is used for delegatecall.
public initialize() only requires _factory() == address(0) before setting the trusted factory.
public initialize() stores the factory address through _setFactory.
initialize() reads the resolved implementation through _implementation().
public initialize() delegatecalls caller supplied data to the factory-resolved implementation.
_setAdmin performs the sstore that changes proxy ownership without any zero-address or authorization check.
_implementation reads the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via sload.
_setImplementation writes newImplementation into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_admin reads the admin address from ADMIN_SLOT via sload.
_setAdmin writes newAdmin into ADMIN_SLOT, changing the privileged account.
_factory reads the factory address from FACTORY_SLOT via sload.
_setFactory writes newFactory into FACTORY_SLOT, controlling future delegatecall targets.
Constructor asserts IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT == bytes32(uint256(keccak256('eip1967.proxy.implementation')) - 1), an unsigned subtraction on the derived constant.
Constructor asserts ADMIN_SLOT == bytes32(uint256(keccak256('eip1967.proxy.admin')) - 1), an unsigned subtraction on the derived constant.
